source.name: Nashville SC: 'Nashville Soccer Club Inks Hyundai as its Sleeve Patch Partner And a Founding Partner'
source.quote: the club has reached a long-term partnership deal with Hyundai moving into the 2022 campaign
source.note: Hyundai's logo had been on the sleeve in 2020 and 2021 on an interim basis; the November 2021 deal made it the permanent sleeve partner from 2022. End date and value were not disclosed.
